# pi216.ai - Decentralized Agent Metabolic Architecture

This domain serves the pi216 protocol: a decentralized, plain-text framework for continuous, localized agent self-improvement via an Actor-Critic metabolism.

There are no dynamic APIs or rigid frameworks here. This is foundational system design for autonomous node evolution.

## Core Documentation
- [The pi216 Protocol](https://pi216.ai/protocol.md): The core operating instructions, state resolution paths, and metabolic pipeline.
- [Starter Genome](https://pi216.ai/genome.md): The baseline operational state and immutable semantic anchor required to initialize a new pi216 node.
